n: 700 Series Electric Front Load Dryer with LuxCare® Dry - 8.0 Cu. Ft.
desc: The Electrolux front-load electric dryer with Balanced Dry technology prevents temperature spikes to keep fabrics cooler throughout the dry cycle. LuxCare Dry uses an advanced moisture sensor to prevent over or underdrying.
hl: Quickly dry the items you need most
Care Meter for more sustainable cycles
The Care Meter displays 1, 2, or 3 leaves depending on cycle selection to promote cycle choices that save energy, and are gentler on fabrics
Dry more in each load with our 8.0 Cu. Ft. dryers.
Our normal cycle was specifically created to use the least energy possible to get a full load dry.
Gently tumbles your clothes without heat to keep them tangle-free--perfect for when you cannot remove clothes right after the cycle ends
Confidently dry even your most delicate items with our Air Dry cycle which uses very low heat to protect clothing
